usageNotes: Use this to register a new webhook endpoint in the cluster notification system so Proxmox can push alerts (backups, HA events, etc.) to an external HTTP receiver. Requires `Mapping.Modify` on `/mapping/notifications` plus either `Sys.Audit`+`Sys.Modify` or `Sys.AccessNetwork` on `/`. Both the `body` and `header` values must be base64-encoded; secrets follow the same property-string format (`name=<name>,value=<base64>`) and are stored encrypted server-side.

examples.summary: Create a webhook that POSTs JSON alerts with an Authorization header and a Bearer token secret

tips: All `value` fields in `header` and `secret` entries must be base64-encoded; plain text will be rejected or misinterpreted.
Webhook names must follow the `pve-configid` format: alphanumeric plus hyphens, no spaces, max 64 chars.
Use template variables like `{{title}}` or `{{secret.mykey}}` inside the base64-encoded `body` to inject notification content or secrets at delivery time.
Create the endpoint in `disable: true` state first to validate config before enabling it in production.
After creation, wire this endpoint to a notification matcher via `post_cluster_notifications_matchers` so it actually receives events.
